questions.explanation: «-yapti» ma'nosi. to be ni hech qachon tushirmang.
CVC (undosh-unli-undosh) qolipida oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: run → running, stop → stopping.
-ie → -ying: die → dying, lie → lying.
Stative fe'llar: want, know, like, love, need, understand, believe, see, cost, belong.

questions.text: «I'm meeting him tomorrow» — bu qaysi ma'no?
questions.explanation: Beshta ma'no: hozir, vaqtinchalik, o'zgarish, kelajak reja, always+ing (g'ashlik).
I/he/she/it → was; you/we/they → were.
she → was.
was/were born — doim shu shaklda ishlatiladi.

questions.text: «Were you there?» ga qisqa javob qanday?
questions.explanation: was/were o'z inkor va savoliga ega — did kerak emas.

options: Holat, joy, sifat uchun — harakat uchun emas
questions.explanation: Harakat uchun -ed yoki irregular V2 ishlatiladi.
Undosh + y → -ied: study → studied, try → tried.

options: didn't dan keyin SOF fe'l keladi: didn't work
questions.explanation: -ed did/didn't ga «ko'chadi», asosiy fe'l sof qoladi.
t/d dan keyin /ɪd/: wanted, needed, started.
Tovushsiz undoshdan keyin /t/; tovushli yoki unlidan keyin /d/ (played, lived).
CVC qolipida oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi.
V1 (go) — V2 (went, o'tgan zamon) — V3 (gone, Perfect uchun).

options: Did dan keyin SOF V1 keladi: Did you go?
questions.explanation: Savol va inkorda irregular shakl ishlatilmaydi.
-ought guruhi: buy/bought, bring/brought, think/thought.
O'zgarmas guruh: cut/cut, put/put, let/let.
Yozilishi bir xil, o'qilishi boshqa. Yana: said → /sed/, heard → /hɜːd/.

title: Test — O'tgan zamon: inkor va savol

questions.explanation: Holat/sifat → was/were; harakat → did/didn't.
Harakat fe'li bilan didn't + sof fe'l.

questions.text: «Didn't you go?» ga «Ha, bordim» qanday javob beriladi?
questions.explanation: Inkor savolga javob FAKTGA qarab beriladi, savol shakliga emas.

questions.text: Hikoyani ketma-ket bayon qilish uchun qaysi so'zlar ishlatiladi?
questions.explanation: Suddenly — kutilmagan burilish uchun.
Suhbatda qiziqish ko'rsatuvchi qisqa javob: Was it? Did you really?
O'tmishda davom etgan, tugamagan ish.

questions.text: «I was reading when he ___ (come)» — to'g'ri shakl?
questions.explanation: when — qisqa voqea (Past Simple); while/as — uzun fon (Past Continuous).

questions.text: «When I arrived, she was cooking» nimani anglatadi?
questions.explanation: «...she cooked» esa: men kelganimdan keyin pishirdi.

questions.text: «She was knowing the answer» — bu nega xato?
options: know — stative fe'l, Continuous da ishlatilmaydi
questions.explanation: To'g'risi: She knew the answer.

questions.text: «He was always coming late» qanday ma'no beradi?
questions.explanation: always + V-ing takroriy g'ashlantiruvchi harakatni bildiradi.
«...moqchi / ...adi» ma'nosi; keyin sof fe'l keladi.

questions.text: «Look at those clouds! It's going to rain» — bu qaysi ma'no?
questions.explanation: Uch ma'no: reja/niyat, dalilga asoslangan bashorat, tez orada sodir bo'lish.

questions.text: «I was going to call, but I forgot» nimani anglatadi?
questions.explanation: was/were going to — bajarilmay qolgan niyat.
«going to» ning og'zaki qisqargan shakli; yozuvda ishlatilmaydi.

questions.text: «be going to» va Present Continuous qanday farqlanadi?
options: going to — niyat; PC — kelishilgan uchrashuv
questions.explanation: I'm going to study medicine (niyat) / I'm meeting him at 5 (kelishilgan).
